episodes.title: Barata Voa
episodes.summary: Benício teams up with Suellen for their first case together. Meanwhile, Rossi greenlights unorthodox methods to solve crimes in his police station.

episodes.title: Vestígios da Noite
episodes.summary: A new agent joins the team, and Benício explains the dynamics of organized crime. Soulless reunites with his former colleagues.

episodes.title: Bicho Homem
episodes.summary: After discovering two new DNA samples, Suellen and Benício follow Roleta. But they're not the only ones tracking the suspect down.

episodes.title: Comboio
episodes.summary: While Suellen recovers, Benício leads the investigation and hears word of a major upcoming heist. This requires Soulless to change tack.

episodes.title: Tudo Pela Família
episodes.summary: Benício and Suellen collect additional DNA samples from other suspects. Yuri and Rossi discuss the Ghost Gang, and Moreira is reassigned.

episodes.title: Em Casa
episodes.summary: Yuri relocates to Brasilia. Suellen and Benício uncover Soulless' real name and his past. A maneuver by the Ghost Gang turns deadly.

episodes.title: Hacienda
episodes.summary: Isaac and Soulless argue. Benício and Suellen deal with pressing family matters. A traitor causes trouble for Rossi and his department.

episodes.title: O Fim e o Início
episodes.summary: While Guilherme succumbs to pressure and Maria Clara gets revenge, Benício and Soulless have a dramatic showdown.

episodes.title: Dia de jogo
episodes.summary: Plans for an audacious bank robbery pit Suellen's team and the Ghost Gang against each other in a lethal battle of wills — and high explosives.

episodes.title: A caça e o caçador
episodes.summary: A tragedy on the team leaves Suellen craving payback. Soulless changes his plans to keep a low profile in prison after his loved ones are put at risk.

episodes.title: Shangri-lá
episodes.summary: As the Ghost Gang hits a jewelry auction, time is running out for Suellen and Benício to get results. A showdown in a brothel ends in bloodshed.

episodes.title: Reféns
episodes.summary: As the criminal group prepares an ambitious double bank hit, Suellen and Benício organize a counterattack at the heart of the Ghost Gang's operation.

episodes.title: Assunto de família
episodes.summary: Suellen and Benício investigate what clues Gabriel's tattoos might hold — but Suellen soon becomes a target for Isaac and his men.

episodes.title: Dupla improvável
episodes.summary: Suellen has to face family issues in the wake of a traumatic event. In Paraguay, Isaac shows the Ambassador no mercy.

episodes.title: A carga fantasma
episodes.summary: After capturing a member of the Ghost Gang during a shoot-out, Suellen uses all possible tricks to make sure she extracts some useful information.

episodes.title: Fronteira dominada
episodes.summary: The Feds inflict serious losses on the Ghost Gang, while matters come to a head for Benício, Suellen and Soulless in the port of Santos.
